title: Variations in oxygenated and nitrogen-containing primary organic compounds based on the fuel type and burning condition in stove emissions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00080G, Paper

Osayomwanbor E. Oghama, Aristeidis Voliotis, Thomas J. Bannan, Sara A. Syafira, Dawei Hu, Huihui Wu, Peter Gallimore, Gordon McFiggans, Hugh Coe, James D. Allan
Differences in primary aerosol composition exist between peat, leaves and wood fuels, while the effect of burning conditions is only noticeable due to the changes in AMS f60. CHO compounds are more abundant but show lesser aromaticity than the CHON.
